27.06.2024 A.O. No. 238 of 2024 
Hon’ble Ritu Bahri, C.J.
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Mr. Pooran Singh Rawat and Mr. Pradeep 
Lohani, learned counsel for the appellant. 
2. Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani, learned counsel 
for the respondent. 
3. Both the parties are directed to remain 
present before the Court on the next date of 
hearing. 
4. The parties in this case were married in the 
year 1987. They are living separately since 
2021. 
5. Counsel for the respondent-husband has 
informed that there is a criminal complaint made 
under the Protection of Woman from Domestic 
Violence Act, which is also pending in Delhi. 
6. Counsel for the appellant-wife says that 
appellant has been given a gift by her brother￾in-law, which includes agricultural land. 
7. To resolve the dispute between the parties 
one attempt can be made by way of mediation 
for an out of court settlement. 
8. List the matter on 19.09.2024. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) (Ritu Bahri, C.J.)

19.09.2024 AO No. 238 of 2024
Hon'ble Ritu Bahri, C.J. 
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Mr. Pradeep Lohani, learned counsel for the 
appellant and Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani, learned counsel 
for the respondent. 
2. The appellant was present in the Court with her 
daughter and Pramod Kumar (respondent) was also 
present. They were referred for Mediation. 
3. As per the Mediation Report, Rs. 1 crore cash 
was offered by the respondent-husband to the 
appellant-wife and the appellant-wife stated that she is 
willing to transfer the property in favour of her younger 
daughter. It was further observed that there was a gap 
in thoughts and perspective of both and that affected 
their marriage. 
4. Keeping in view the report of the Mediator, this 
matter is adjourned for February, 2025. On that day, 
both the parties will again go for Mediation so that they 
can take a correct decision for future of their daughter, 
who is staying with the mother. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J) (Ritu Bahri, CJ) 
 19.09.2024 19.09.2024
